name: @monorepo/tools-github
description: GitHub CLI automation and repository management tools.
author: Tupynambá Lucas Varela Rodrigues <tupynambalucas.dev>

scripts.github:services:up: podman compose -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml up -d gh git
scripts.github:services:reset: podman compose -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml down --volumes && podman compose -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml up -d --build gh git
